description: Source code for AndroidModuleBuilder class, part of JetBrains Android plugin, responsible for creating and configuring Android modules within an IDE, including project setup, resource creation, manifest configuration, and integration with Android SDK tools.

classes.name: AndroidModuleBuilder
classes.description: Main class for building and configuring Android modules within the IDE, including project setup, resource creation, manifest configuration, and SDK integration.

classes.name: AndroidModuleBuilder.Library
classes.description: Subclass representing an Android library module builder.

classes.name: AndroidModuleBuilder.Test
classes.description: Subclass representing an Android test module builder.

methods.name: setupRootModel
methods.description: Configures the module's root model, including SDK, content roots, and project-specific settings.

methods.name: createProject
methods.description: Creates the project structure, either via Android tools or manually.

methods.name: createDirectoryStructure
methods.description: Creates the directory layout for an Android application project.

methods.name: createProjectByAndroidTool
methods.description: Uses Android SDK command-line tools to generate project files and structure.

methods.name: createManifestFileAndAntFiles
methods.description: Creates AndroidManifest.xml and related build files from templates.

methods.name: configureManifest
methods.description: Modifies the AndroidManifest.xml to set SDK version and other attributes.

methods.name: assignApplicationName
methods.description: Sets the application name resource and updates the manifest label.

methods.name: createResourcesAndLibs
methods.description: Creates resource directories and default resource files.

methods.name: createFileFromResource
methods.description: Creates a resource file from a classpath resource.

methods.name: addRunConfiguration
methods.description: Adds a run configuration for the Android module.

methods.name: addTestRunConfiguration
methods.description: Adds a test run configuration for the Android module.

methods.name: isHelloAndroid
methods.description: Checks if the project is a 'Hello Android' sample based on activity name.

methods.name: findSourceRoot
methods.description: Finds the source root directory in the module.

methods.name: createPackageIfPossible
methods.description: Creates package directories within the source directory.

methods.name: createActivityAndSetupManifest
methods.description: Creates an activity and updates the manifest accordingly.

methods.name: getAndroidSdkForModule
methods.description: Retrieves the Android SDK associated with a module.

methods.name: runAndroidTool
methods.description: Executes an Android SDK command-line tool and captures output.
